title: Tangent measure of the Gauss–Green measure is H^m on ν(y)^⊥ almost everywhere (De Giorgi; Simon 4.3 (†))
statement: Let m ≥ 1. Suppose D ⊆ ℝ^{m+1} is open, F ⊆ ℝ^{m+1} is Borel, μ is a Borel measure on ℝ^{m+1} with μ(ℝ^{m+1} \ D) = 0 and μ(K) < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ D, ν : ℝ^{m+1} → ℝ^{m+1} is Borel with |ν(z)| = 1 for every z, and the Gauss–Green identity (GG) ∫_F div φ dL^{m+1} = −∫⟨φ, ν⟩ dμ holds for every C¹ compactly supported φ : ℝ^{m+1} → ℝ^{m+1} with tsupport φ ⊆ D (div φ = trace Dφ, L^{m+1} = volume). Then for μ-a.e. y and every continuous compactly supported f : ℝ^{m+1} → ℝ, r^{-m} ∫ f(r^{-1}(z − y)) dμ(z) → ∫_{(span{ν(y)})^⊥} f dH^m as r ↓ 0, where H^m = μHE[m].
